items.title: Instagram launches content protection tool for unauthorised reposts and AI-modification
items.excerpt: Instagram is rolling out 'content protection', which detects unauthorised reposts of creators' original Reels and is being extended to flag AI-modified versions of their content - relevant to musicians whose clips get remixed by AI.
items.rationale: New platform feature musicians can switch on now to catch reposted and AI-modified versions of their Reels.

items.title: Mooer debuts Future Flex, a next-gen amp modeler with a built-in speaker, AI and NAM A2
items.excerpt: Mooer's Future Flex all-in-one amp modeler packs 55 amp models, 69 effects, a built-in speaker, an AI tone assistant and NAM A2 neural-capture compatibility.
items.rationale: Fresh hardware launch putting an AI tone assistant and NAM A2 neural captures into a single guitar modeler.

items.title: Hive Launches AI Assistants to Help Venues and Promoters Sell More Tickets
items.excerpt: Fan-marketing platform Hive launched AI assistants that automatically draft email and SMS campaigns for venues and promoters, freeing live-event marketers to focus on strategy and creative.
items.rationale: Concrete product launch for the live-music business side: AI-drafted email/SMS ticket campaigns.

items.title: 김하온 복제한 AI 등장…"일주일 안에 넘어보겠다"
items.excerpt: 래퍼 김하온과 그의 목소리·말투·음악을 학습한 AI 도플갱어 '노아(NOAH)'가 SBS 다큐 '나의 이방인' 3부 'AI, 나를 닮은 너'(22일 방송)에서 랩 대결을 펼친다.
items.rationale: Korean artist vs. his own AI voice clone on SBS airing today - timely local angle on artist cloning.

items.title: Harmonic Circuit: Chord Progression Lies in a Sparse Principal Information Flow in Symbolic Music Models
items.excerpt: Mechanistic-interpretability study that locates sparse 'circuits' inside symbolic music transformers responsible for chord-progression prediction, opening a path to more controllable AI composition models.
items.rationale: New research locating the chord-progression circuitry in symbolic music models - a route to more controllable composition AI.
